note_verbatim: Michael Polanyi, F.R.S., was born in Budapest. He resigned his life-membership of Kaiser Wilhelm Institute fur Physikalische Chemie in 1933 in protest to anti-Jewish legislation. Later he joined the University of Manchester first as professor of Physical Chemistry and then as professor of Economic and Social Studies. Amongst his many distinguished publications on Science and Humanities "The Logic of Liberty" is perhaps the best known. Personal Knowledge-Towards a post-Critical Philosophy has recently been published by Routledge & Kegan Paul.
